title: Vohringer Home Technology acquiert 51 % d’un fabricant d’équipements pour circuits imprimés pour 214,2 millions de yuans
Vohringer Home Technology to Acquire 51% of PCB Equipment Maker for 214 Million Yuan
Vohringer Home Technology erwirbt 51% an Leiterplatten-Ausrüster für 214 Mio. Yuan
Vohringer Home Technology Co.,Ltd. agreed to acquire 51% stake in Nanjing Ceres Automatic Technology Co., Ltd. from Qin Zaocai and Yang Zhenyu for approximately CNY 210 million.
